qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: DSV is a best-in-class logistics consolidator with an unmatched M&A integration engine and asset-light scale economies shared. However, air and ocean forwarding remains an intermediary brokerage business where enterprise shippers multi-source and tender volume regularly with low switching costs, leaving DSV unable to exert autonomous pricing power >= inflation across the cycle without losing volume.
qualitative.note: Rejected at Gate 3b (Pricing & Proof of Moat). Although DSV possesses an exceptional acquisition integration playbook (crowned by the €14.3B DB Schenker transaction) and attractive asset-light capital efficiency, freight forwarding lacks structural switching costs. Shippers regularly tender routes on price, making DSV a price-taker on freight spreads without autonomous pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Reported pre-tax ROIC including goodwill ranges from 15% to 25%, but EBIT declined ~36% between 2022 and 2024 as pandemic-era freight premiums evaporated. Gross profit per unit is dictated by global shipping supply/demand balances rather than proprietary pricing power, and customer tender cycles ensure low customer lock-in.
